scope: Engine plus controlled DOM. Synthetic events explicitly named; native browser and assistive hardware checked separately. No canon subtitles/art.

checks.name: Disabled by default: no history, audio context, persistent writes or game changes
All 346 identities are observed read-only without requiring sound or source reclassification
Enabling late starts from the current cursor, never displays the past attack backlog
Gatling captions count exactly the six emitted shots and group close repeats
Interrupted bursts do not describe the five reserved but cancelled bullets
Delayed independent projectiles are described when moving, not during reservation
Lucas placement, arming and explosion remain distinct; secondary blast event is not duplicated
Empty detonator explains the absence of armed charges without inventing a blast
Blocked damage names the defender and is not repeated as a normal impact
Healing is described only for health actually restored; annotations use fixed participant IDs
Pause freezes text; overlays expire in simulation ticks, not wall time or paint calls
Seek to another state clears transcript and never claims an unobserved full history
Frame rewind and clear do not replay stale captions on a later draw
Large unobserved advances are labelled partial instead of claiming every event was recorded
The transcript and repeated-source queue stay bounded over a long fixture stream
Synthetic draw/guard break/results distinguish the affected participant without guessing dialogue
Announcements are excluded during pause, hidden pages, acceleration and manual steps
Malformed state and control characters remain safe; exported journal views cannot mutate the observer
Three full CPU replays and their exported data are byte-identical with or without text observation
Main panel pauses, stays keyboard-contained and restores a running match without writes
Closing a panel opened from pause leaves the game paused; blur cannot auto-resume it
Actual main controller emits captions while its audio remains disabled
Trial mode, imports and overlay journal do not add progression writes or a second animation loop
HTML-looking names are text nodes, not executable markup; hidden modal restores inert state
Conserved navigation closes the text panel without a forced resume or duplicated listener loop
Fighters, moves, stages, Dossiers, artwork and all three replay/journal contracts are preserved
